current.text: He has no clear path to minutes behind Ajay Mitchell, Cason Wallace, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Bennett Stirtz.
His numbers in his two NBA starts were very strong.
He is listed as questionable on Yahoo with a back problem.
This season could be his first healthy one.
He is eligible for a contract extension after this season.

durable.text: He has a long injury history: a torn ACL before his draft year, testicular cancer treatment and back surgery.
He is a pass-first, traditional point guard.
He showed improved pull-up shooting in the G League.
Ryland is not sure the improved pull-up shooting is real.
